messages:
Nora (Support): Lumos Inc reports they were charged twice for the same batch job on INV-2026-0152. They attached the invoice screenshot and timestamps.

Nora (Support): Customer claims the duplicate line appeared after a retry window; asking for a refund/credit.

Tariq (BillingOps): Pulling invoice... INV-2026-0152 total: $4,320. Line items: gen-endpoint: $1,800, gen-endpoint (duplicate): $1,800, misc fees: $720. No promos.

BillingBot (system): Audit snapshot:
- Charge events: CHG-56220 and CHG-56221 at 2026-06-02 09:12 UTC
- Retry job ID: RET-9901 created automatic re-bill during failure window
- Note: duplicate charge matches retry timestamp.

Sam (Finance): Standard procedure: issue a customer credit equal to duplicate line ($1,800) and post under GL-4105 (Billing corrections). Approve to proceed?

Ivy (Sales): Lumos is a renewal candidate; please do full refund to keep momentum. Sales will absorb via experiment budget.

Sam (Finance): Approved. Tariq please run adjustment and attach audit IDs to ticket SL-1145.

Tariq (BillingOps): Running command:
redwood-bill adjust --cust LU-304 --invoice INV-2026-0152 --amount -1800 --type credit --gl GL-4105 --note "Duplicate charge from retry RET-9901; CHG-56220/56221"

BillingBot (system): Adjustment executed by billing_ops at 1773055400. Adjustment ID ADJ-34102. New invoice PDF: https://console.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0152/adjusted/ADJ-34102.pdf

Sam (Finance): Confirming ADJ-34102 and logging ACCT-7921 for month-end.

Nora (Support): Customer notified: "We've issued a $1,800 credit to correct the duplicate charge on INV-2026-0152. Apologies for the inconvenience." :white_check_mark:

Ivy (Sales): Noted and sending renewal outreach. Closing thread."
